title: Elevating Government Operations: Empowering Agencies with Secure Solutions
lead: Secure, interoperable mobile identity for agencies, ministries, and the citizens they serve.
seoDescription: Explore how Scytáles helps governmental and defence agencies with secure mobile identity solutions.

sections.heading: The challenges
points: Government services have grown siloed over time.
They remain over-dependent on physical identification credentials.
Agencies struggle to know who they are actually serving.
Citizens are inconvenienced by antiquated processes.
Administering agencies and ministries lose efficiency.
Fraud opportunities open up at credential issuance.
Benefits programmes are exposed to the same fraud.
Relying entities cannot reliably verify identity.

sections.heading: Our approach
sections.lead: A standardized digital identification instrument, more secure and privacy-centric than any physical credential — the holder decides what is released and to whom. Alongside it, a wallet built to hold, organize and use those credentials, validated over Bluetooth, NFC, WiFi Aware or QR, in person or online.

sections.heading: Why choose Scytáles
rail: A leader and prominent contributor to the standardization of mobile identity credentials since 2015.
Represents the Swedish Institute for Standards at ISO — mobile driving licences (WG10, 18013 series) and mobile identity standards (WG4, 23220 series).
The first company to achieve UL conformity assessment, and then certification, for its mDL technology.
Selected by the European Commission to build the Digital Identity reference implementation for the European Union — the EUDI Wallet.
Delivered the first ever ISO-compliant mDL programme, in Utah, with North American partner GET Group — including the work to cultivate a full ecosystem of relying parties.
A proud member of a number of prestigious associations and alliances, and ISO 27001 certified.
